evidence: Carries the Utils/log/libs label and modifies socket wait timeout logic in src/util/sock.cpp.
rationale: Fixes a regression from #34342 where running bitcoin-cli with -rpcclienttimeout=0 fails immediately on macOS with 'Could not connect to the server'. Capping the timeout at INT_MAX milliseconds prevents select() from failing with EINVAL and restores the documented no-timeout behavior.
